verdict.rationale: GitHub's own writing-and-formatting docs say users can "create sophisticated formatting for your prose and code on GitHub with simple syntax," which covers the core of the story: formatted prose and code written with lightweight syntax. The pack is a single thin doc line, though, and does not spell out the surfaces or the highlighting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that this applies to READMEs, issues and comments, explicit mention of Markdown and syntax-highlighted code blocks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
